name: IRS standard mileage rate, business (self-employed and business)
value: 76 cents per mile from July 1, 2026 (was 72.5 cents per mile Jan 1 to Jun 30, 2026)
applies_to: Miles driven July 1 to Dec 31, 2026 (Announcement 2026-11, IRB 2026-29, July 13, 2026)
source_phrase: Self-employed and business: 76 cents/mile
next_change_window: 2027 rate is usually released in late December (2026 rate came in IR-2025-128 on Dec 29, 2025). Mid-year changes are rare (this was the first since 2022).

name: IRS standard deduction, tax year 2026
source_phrase: the standard deduction rises to $16,100 for tax year 2026
next_change_window: Tax year 2027 inflation adjustments are usually released in October or November (the 2026 release came Oct 9, 2025). Not yet released as of Oct 4, 2026.

name: IRS 2026 marginal rate thresholds, single filers
source_phrase: top tax rate remains 37% for individual single taxpayers with incomes greater than $640,600
next_change_window: Same as standard deduction: tax year 2027 Rev. Proc. usually October or November.
affects: S corp vs sole prop calculators

name: Self-employment tax rate
value: 15.3% total = 12.4% Social Security (OASDI, up to the wage base) + 2.9% Medicare (no cap)
source_phrase: The self-employment tax rate is 15.3%.
next_change_window: Only changes by legislation. Note: this IRS page still shows the 2024 wage base example ($168,600); use SSA for the current base.
affects: Etsy seller and STR host profit calculators

name: Social Security contribution and benefit base (taxable maximum)
source_phrase: slated to increase to $184,500 from $176,100
next_change_window: 2027 base is announced together with the 2027 COLA, which follows the September CPI release.
next_change_date: 2026-10-14 (expected, not posted by SSA; BLS releases September 2026 CPI that day)

name: Social Security cost-of-living adjustment (COLA)
source_phrase: will increase 2.8 percent in 2026
next_change_window: 2027 COLA is announced when BLS publishes September CPI. SSA's COLA page does not yet post a 2027 announcement date. Last year's announcement (Oct 24, 2025) was later than usual.
next_change_date: 2026-10-14 (expected; based on BLS September 2026 CPI release date, not an SSA-posted date)
affects: budget templates for retirees selling on Etsy or hosting

name: BLS CPI release date for September 2026 CPI (drives 2027 COLA and wage base)
source_phrase: September 2026 | Oct. 14, 2026 | 08:30 AM
next_change_window: Following releases on the same page: October 2026 CPI on Nov 10, 2026; November 2026 CPI on Dec 10, 2026. December 2026 CPI date not shown on the page as fetched.
affects: any product indexed to CPI (COLA, state minimum wages, pricing escalators)

name: Federal minimum wage (FLSA)
source_phrase: must pay the current Federal minimum wage of $7.25 per hour
next_change_window: Only by Congress; no change scheduled. DOL state page last updated July 1, 2026.

name: DOL State Minimum Wage Laws page (master list of state rates)
value: Lists each state's current rate; only Michigan's entry names a Jan 1, 2027 increase ($15.00). 30 states plus DC above federal; 13 at $7.25 (incl. IA, ID, IN, KS, KY, NC, ND, NH, OK, PA, TX, UT, WI); AL, GA, LA, MS, SC, TN, WY no law or below federal.
source_phrase: scheduled to increase on January 1, 2027 to $15.00 per hour
next_change_window: DOL usually refreshes after Jan 1 and July 1 changes. State labor departments publish indexed rates first (mostly Aug to Oct).

name: FUTA tax rate, wage base, and effective rate after credit
value: 6.0% on the first $7,000 per employee; up to 5.4% credit; 0.6% effective rate (so $42 per employee at the $7,000 cap, by arithmetic) when full credit applies
applies_to: Ongoing (statutory); credit reduction states pay more
source_phrase: the FUTA tax rate after credit is 0.6%
next_change_window: Rate and base change only by legislation. Credit reduction states are announced by DOL after the Nov 10 deadline each year (IRS FUTA credit reduction page).

name: USPS First-Class Mail Forever stamp price
applies_to: Since July 12, 2026 (confirmed on USPS letter rate history page)
source_phrase: Forever stamp from 78 cents to 82 cents
next_change_window: Mailing services price changes are filed with the PRC about 90 days ahead; USPS kept stamps flat in January 2026 and raised them in July.

name: USPS January 2027 price change (filed or announced?)
value: UNVERIFIED: no January 2027 price filing found on USPS newsroom (about.usps.com, news.usps.com) or in PRC search results as of Oct 7, 2026
source_phrase: the price of a First-Class Mail stamp will not change
next_change_window: Last cycle, January shipping prices were announced Nov 14, 2025 for a Jan 18, 2026 effective date (and stamps did not change). Expect a filing around mid-November 2026 if USPS follows the same pattern.

name: USPS 2026 holiday temporary price change (shipping products)
value: In effect 12 a.m. CT Oct 4, 2026 until 12 a.m. CT Jan 17, 2027 on Priority Mail Express, Priority Mail, Ground Advantage, Parcel Select (PRC Docket CP2026-10)
source_phrase: remain in place until 12 a.m. CT on Jan. 17, 2027
next_change_window: Ends Jan 17, 2027.
live_listings: #7 (check its USPS rates against holiday pricing)

source_phrase: a time-limited price change to better align its costs of transportation

name: Etsy listing fee
source_phrase: The listing fee is a flat rate charge of $0.20 USD per listing.
next_change_window: No fixed schedule; Etsy announces changes via Seller Handbook and the Fees & Payments Policy. Policy page shows 'Last updated on Oct 5, 2026' with no change notice found.

name: Etsy transaction fee
value: 6.5% of the total order amount (item price plus shipping and gift wrap)
source_phrase: Etsy charges 6.5% of the total order amount
next_change_window: No fixed schedule. Watch etsy.com/legal/fees.

name: Etsy Payments processing fee, US bank account
applies_to: Current, shops with a US bank account
next_change_window: No fixed schedule.

name: Etsy Offsite Ads fee
value: 15% if under $10,000 sales in prior 365 days; 12% once a shop reaches $10,000
source_phrase: you will pay a fee of 15%
next_change_window: No fixed schedule.

name: Airbnb split-fee structure, host share
value: Host 3% (4% for Brazil and Mexico listings); guest fee 14.1% to 16.5% of booking subtotal
applies_to: Current for hosts not yet migrated; Airbnb is moving home hosts to the single fee
source_phrase: Most hosts pay a 3% service fee, but some pay more.
next_change_window: Being phased out. Airbnb's Jul 7, 2026 (updated Aug 24, 2026) Resource Center post set price-adjust deadlines of Sept 15, 2026 (outside EEA) and Oct 13, 2026 (EEA and Switzerland).

name: Airbnb single (host-only) service fee
value: 15.5% for most hosts (others typically 14% to 16%; 16% for Brazil and Mexico)
applies_to: Current; applies to reservations made after a host switches to the single fee
source_phrase: Most hosts pay 15.5%, remaining hosts typically pay 14%-16%
next_change_window: No fixed schedule.

name: IRS 2026 estimated tax, 4th payment due date
value: Jan 15, 2027 (Friday). Not required if 2026 return filed by Feb 1, 2027 with full payment.
applies_to: Tax year 2026 (Q1 Apr 15, Q2 Jun 15, Q3 Sept 15, 2026)
source_phrase: 4th payment ... Jan. 15, 2027
next_change_window: Fixed by rule.

value: UNVERIFIED: 2027 Form 1040-ES not yet published. Expected by rule: Apr 15, 2027; Jun 15, 2027; Sept 15, 2027; Jan 18, 2028 (Jan 15, 2028 is a Saturday and Jan 17 is MLK Day)
source_phrase: Payments are due on the 15th day of the 4th, 6th, and 9th months
